footprints.scope: Closed building ways and multipolygon buildings; building:part excluded

method.alignment: Source coordinates; no fitted footprint shift
method.heightDefinition: p95 selected roof Z (vendor class 6, or explicitly labelled planar class-1 candidates) minus median class-2 ground Z in 3–8 m ring, expanded to 15 m if needed; no unrelated DEM fallback
method.limitations: Not current-building validation; acquisition dates are in source metadata. Roof classification, footprint age and ring-ground slope can bias heights. Per-record grade D until independently calibrated.

unclassifiedRoof.note: Conservative general candidate filter, authored before inspecting derived heights; not calibrated. Uses existing params.json normals/regionGrow tolerances. Class 1 fallback only when the survey has no class 6.

source.originalVerticalUnits: US survey foot (source bounds conversion verified)
source.title: USGS 3DEP SC_SavannahPeeDee_2019_B19 (delivery SC_SavannahPeeDee_2_2019)
source.verticalEvidenceNote: Original LAS header min/max Z multiplied by 1200/3937 match the EPT source bounds to <1e-6 m. EPT Z is already metres; no conversion applied. This checks units, not absolute vertical accuracy.
